## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add ai-agents`. Mount `<RunnerDashboard />` at /agents. Trigger runs via `runAgent({agentSlug, input, scheduleAt?})`. Cron scheduler via Convex cron — wire if you need scheduled runs. Agent definitions managed in ai-admin.
